title: Definitions.
bodyText:
[See Note at beginning of chapter.] As used in this chapter:

"Commission" means the Hawaii climate change mitigation and adaptation commission.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text:
Repeal of chapter on July 1, 2022, by L 2017, c 32, §§6, 10, as shown in the main volume, deleted by L 2018, c 15, §4(2).
The source note to this section is amended to read as follows: "L 2014, c 83, pt of §2; am L 2017, c 32, §§4, 6, and 10; am L 2018, c 15, §4".

bodyHtml:
§225P-2  Definitions.  [See Note at beginning of chapter.]  As used in this chapter:

     "Commission" means the Hawaii climate change mitigation and adaptation commission. [L 2014, c 83, pt of §2; am L 2017, c 32, §4]

 

Note

 

  Repeal of chapter on July 1, 2022, by L 2017, c 32, §§6, 10, as shown in the main volume, deleted by L 2018, c 15, §4(2).

  The source note to this section is amended to read as follows:  "L 2014, c 83, pt of §2; am L 2017, c 32, §§4, 6, and 10; am L 2018, c 15, §4".
